relation.note: Al-Ẓāhir Khushqadam was his khujdāsh (fellow mamluk of al-Muʾayyad Shaykh); as sultan he granted him a weak amirate close to a soldier's rank.

state.note: A weak amirate close to a soldier's rank, granted by his khujdāsh al-Ẓāhir Khushqadam.

event.desc: Was granted a weak amirate close to a soldier's rank by his khujdāsh al-Ẓāhir Khushqadam.
event.note: Granted at some point during Khushqadam's sultanate (865-872 AH), after prolonged service as a soldier.
Occurred before his death in Muḥarram 873 AH.

person.note: ジャンバク・アル＝ムアイヤディー・シャイフ。ジャンバク・シャイフとして知られる。彼の兵士としての暮らしは長く続いたが、やがて同輩（フジュダーシュ）であったアッ＝ザーヒル・フシュカダムが、兵士の身分に近い弱小のアミール職を彼に授けた。そのまま873年ムハッラム月（第1月）に、老いて無職のまま亡くなった。彼は怠惰で快楽に耽溺する者の一人であった。

Jānbak al-Muʾayyadī Shaykh, also known as Jānbak Shaykh. His service as a common soldier was prolonged until his khujdāsh (fellow mamluk) al-Ẓāhir Khushqadam granted him a weak amirate close to a soldier's rank. He remained so until he died in Muḥarram 873 AH, old and out of office. He was one of the negligent and self-indulgent.
